invariants: Public filterSessions/filterEvents materialize detached filters before the first asynchronous boundary, including mutation after the call and before awaiting.
Invalid filters retain literal source name/code/message; missing values, explicit null bounds, booleans and non-finite bounds are refused. Nullable metadata values remain valid.
Invalid filters precede cancellation and persistence work; operational failures and aborts retain original causes/reasons.
Event documents classify current/shadowed/log-only against the complete canonical surface fold and preserve raw ascending log order.
Literal matching escapes regex metacharacters and uses the enumerated ECMAScript whitespace set, BOM trimming and source I/dotted-I/dotless-I cases.
Whitespace-only text fails during predicate compilation even if the document collection is empty.
Actual canonical JSONL none/zstd filtering consumers remain cold and return detached semantic text without retaining full logs or mutating durable messages.
identity: Caller filter arrays are copied synchronously; supplied signal and operational error/cause identity survive. Source document seq/surface/text are retained.
ownership: Query owns materialized clauses across await; caller owns original inputs and detached result records/documents.
ordering: Materialization precedes async source work; full surface classification precedes semantic document filtering; input order is preserved.
errors: Thirty-three literal source/native observations freeze typed diagnostics and operational reason/cause. Malformed typed fields never default to empty successful filters.
cancellation: Enumerated pre-abort performs no provider access; invalid filter rejection precedes pre-abort as in the source service.
adaptation: A synchronous Python call prefix captures clauses and returns an awaitable even for validation failure. Python regex explicitly represents ECMAScript whitespace and excludes its extra I-case equivalents.
open_questions: New clean complete gate and actual extracted acceptance remain mandatory. Controlled listing/inspection seams are separate from four actual canonical JSONL none/zstd consumers. Complete Unicode version/case-fold parity, all extraction/plugin event types, full FTS/ranking/cursors/generations, provider epochs/Task cancellation, complete Web/profile and deferred Win7 remain unaccepted.

rc1_review.scope: Current finite executable provider/consumer corpora, original-browser and extracted observations in the single full receipt. Historical alpha evidence remains historical; no inventory-wide parity, arbitrary ABI/history, paid-provider or Win7 certification.
